narrative.overview: Smart Split Bill presents a disciplined, utilitarian interface designed for post-meal financial clarity. It replaces cumbersome spreadsheets and opaque calculation apps with a clean accounting workspace that feels transparent, trustworthy, and lightweight. Every visual element communicates mathematical precision, privacy, and speed.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained monochrome foundation (deep slate ink on clean bone canvas) with purposeful semantic accents.
Hairline geometry: 1px structural borders establish division without visual weight.
Compact, responsive touch targets calibrated for mobile cafe tables and desktop keyboards.
High-density data tables optimized for quick scanning of receipt items and individual allocations.

rules.name: The Ink and Canvas Rule
rules.body: Dark Slate (#0f172a) is reserved for authoritative elements—primary CTAs, active steps, and title text. Backgrounds remain strictly calm pale bone (#f8fafc) and crisp white (#ffffff). Accent colors never act as background fills for large surfaces.

rules.name: The Semantic Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Emerald, Amber, and Rose appear exclusively to convey factual state (operational readiness, confidence warnings, or destruction/removal). They are never applied as decorative badges.

rules.name: The Tabular Precision Rule
rules.body: Every numeric price and quantity display must use monospaced or tabular numeral features to guarantee vertical decimal alignment across multi-item receipt tables.

rules.name: The Hairline Boundary Rule
rules.body: No floating cards with heavy elevation. If two surfaces touch or nest, separate them using a 1px #e2e8f0 border, not a drop shadow.

dos: Do format every currency amount using Indonesian locale (id-ID) with Rp prefix and period thousand separators (e.g. Rp 45.000).
Do ensure individual portion splits sum exactly to the bill total down to Rp 0 difference using the Largest Remainder algorithm.
Do keep cards grounded with 1px #e2e8f0 borders and white backgrounds over the #f8fafc canvas.
Do allow inline manual editing for all OCR-extracted values (names, quantities, prices, taxes).
donts: Don't use saturated bright accent colors for primary button backgrounds or page banners.
Don't use heavy blur backdrops or multi-layered floating drop shadows.
Don't hide tax, service charge, or item discounts inside opaque calculations; itemize every deduction transparently.
Don't introduce user authentication modals, account creation prompts, or persistent database forms.
